integrity: The finite-size stationary formula is attributed to earlier literature. The sharp asymptotic is supported by an explicit ratio proof and standalone numerical corroboration, not an independent audit. No empirical observation or external mathematical certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Single deterministic linear side branch on a finite periodic backbone; strictly positive fixed rates, q not equal to one, capacity-matched N=M or its complementary case, and M/L tending to a finite positive constant. Mean stationary current only; no dynamic fluctuations or bias-to-unity crossover. Other general saddle results may overlap; independent priority assessment is absent.
title: Logarithmic current leakage at the capacity threshold of a long-branch exclusion process
